label: CPS-LAI-02 Physical Telemetry (READ ONLY)
info:
PHYSICAL TELEMETRY INTEGRATION
Six persistent read-only subscriptions and an independent non-overlapping 2-second OPC UA read cycle feed an isolated CPS-LAI-02 cache. A separate 1-second clock publishes real cached snapshots to cpslai2/data. Collection and publication timestamps remain distinct; samples become stale after 6 seconds. No writes, commands, inferred modes, status, OEE, Health, lifecycle, PPU, Governance or HCM.

name: READ ONLY — real telemetry; mode semantics remain unvalidated
info: Six NodeIds were observed with Good OPC UA quality and transitions in two physical experiments (311 and 106 events across 352 monitored tags). This evidence confirms addressability and change, not Manual/Automatic/Step-by-Step semantics.
